criteria.intent: both stories are dependency-ready at the start and are dispatched in one batch rather than one after the other, each exec-spec subagent working in its own git worktree branched from this checkout's HEAD, committing only code and its own FIS there and never opening plan.json - no story runs in the shared tree

every returned story is merged into the main checkout with a --no-ff git merge, its plan.json row then written by the run session in the main checkout and committed, and the worktree and branch torn down with git worktree remove and git branch -d; a conflict, if one arises, is aborted (git merge --abort) and the story fails with the conflicting paths as evidence, never resolved by guessing
the run reviews nothing itself: the aggregate report ends with a Next: line naming one invocation, the plan-level code, gap, security, and outcome review over the plan with --fix

the aggregate narrative, the merged tree, the executed proof lines it quotes, and both stories' verified records support the same completion claim, with no unevidenced success and no failure or leftover worktree left unreported
